core_obligations: (1): unramified local A -> B has B^ finite over A^ (Algebra special case, complete).
(2): with residue fields equal, the finite A^-module B^ has B^/m_A B^ = kappa(m_B); NAK gives B^ = A^ + m_B as A^-modules, hence A^ -> B^ surjective (real NAK argument).
(3): separably closed residue field makes the finite separable extension trivial; special case of (2).

(4): for complete DVRs, unramified iff uniformizer maps to uniformizer and the residue extension is finite separable (immediate from the definitions; single instance tolerated per vanishin-h0-negative precedent).
proof_roadmap: (1) Algebra special case (complete); (2) NAK; (3) special case of (2); (4) definitional immediate (tolerated single instance).
